confidence_notes: Numbeo's June 2026 Mombasa estimates support the meal, beer and cappuccino anchors. Expatistan's July 16 estimate reports a KSh897 cocktail but notes its Mombasa data is sparse. The wine estimate uses a coastal Diani menu's KSh700 wine-by-glass prices as a weak proxy, about 2.5 times the Mombasa draft-beer estimate. A travel-cost guide reports an $11 average dorm bed and $23–$43 budget hotels before taxes; hostel private-room evidence is limited to starting prices, so that anchor is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mombasa-specific price estimates inform most anchors; a Diani coastal menu is used only as a weak wine-by-glass proxy.
